purpose: Teach: 至極/入団/簡易裁判所/身動き/座標/品番/邦題/体勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品の出来栄えは至極満足だ
lines.en: I'm quite satisfied with how our new product has turned out.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Mild warmth beneath the formality—not cold. Steady pace, clear enunciation. Slight pause after 'satisfied,' as if confirming the assessment himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の入団歓迎会を準備しております
lines.en: Yes. We're preparing the welcome reception for our new staff members.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Clipped efficiency but not rushed. Eyes forward. The tone of someone taking notes, ready to move to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、係争は簡易裁判所で解決しろ
lines.en: Handle the dispute through small claims court.
lines.style: Direct, instructional. No flourish. Brief breath before the verb—this is an order, not a suggestion. Steady eye contact implied. Authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の身動きが取れない状況です
lines.en: Yes. The market situation is currently at a standstill.
lines.style: Factual, unflinching. Delivers the constraint without excuse-making. Even tone throughout. Slight tightness in the delivery—acknowledging the difficulty without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新店舗の座標を確定しろ
lines.en: Finalize the coordinates for the new store location.
lines.style: Concise, businesslike command. No preamble. Emphasis on 'finalize'—this needs closure. Clipped cadence. The voice of someone who has already moved forward mentally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の品番を統一しました
lines.en: Yes. We've standardized the product numbers across inventory.
lines.style: Steady confirmation with undertone of completion. Professional pride in the detail work. Measured pace. Slight lift at the end—the satisfaction of a task closed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外作品の邦題を慎重に選べ
lines.en: Choose the Japanese titles for overseas works with care.
lines.style: Measured caution. Emphasis falls on 'with care'—this is about thoughtfulness, not speed. Slight lean into the instruction. The tone of someone who understands nuance matters here.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場攻略の体勢を整えました
lines.en: Yes. We're positioned and ready for market expansion.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation with quiet confidence. Finality beneath—this preparation is complete. Even breath. The last line of a report delivered with composure.
